headword: {健康|けんこう}{食品|しょくひん}

definitions.explanation: Food products marketed for their health benefits, including organic foods, functional foods, and dietary supplements.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}{食品|しょくひん}をよく{買|か}う。
{健康|けんこう}{食品|しょくひん}の{市場|しじょう}は{年々|ねんねん}{拡大|かくだい}している。
examples.english: The health food market is expanding year by year.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}{食品|しょくひん}だからといって{食|た}べすぎると{逆効果|ぎゃくこうか}になることもある。
examples.english: Just because something is health food doesn't mean eating too much of it won't have the opposite effect.

notes:
USAGE:
A broad category in Japan that includes supplements, organic products, and functional foods. Japan has specific regulatory categories for these products.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {健康|けんこう}{食品|しょくひん}コーナー (health food section)
- {健康|けんこう}{食品|しょくひん}{売|う}り{場|ば} (health food department)

RELATED WORDS:
- サプリメント: supplement
- {栄養|えいよう}{補助|ほじょ}{食品|しょくひん}: nutritional supplement food
- {特定|とくてい}{保健用|ほけんよう}{食品|しょくひん}: foods for specified health uses (トクホ)
